Commercial Drain Cleaning & Jetting

We clear grease lines, floor drains and mains, scheduled around your service hours where we can.

Get a Quote Call 803-600-4357

What It Is

Commercial drains carry far more grease, food waste and traffic than a home's. We clear them with cable machines and high-pressure jetting, and use cameras to see what's causing repeat problems.

Signs You Need It

  • Floor drains backing up during service
  • Slow prep, dish or mop sinks
  • Odors from drains in the kitchen or restrooms
  • The same line clogging again and again

What To Expect

We work out which lines are affected and when we can get to them with the least disruption. We clear the line, confirm it flows, and tell you what we found so you can plan ahead.

Commercial Services

What We Handle

  • Restaurant & Grease Line Jetting

    Grease hardens on pipe walls until the line chokes off. High-pressure jetting scours the pipe clean and helps keep a busy kitchen open.

    What's included

    • High-pressure jetting of kitchen lines
    • Clearing prep, dish and mop sink branches
    • Flushing grease and debris downstream
    • Flow test when finished

    Common signs you need this

    • Kitchen drains slowing during service
    • Grease odor from drains
    • Backups after heavy prep days
    Get a Quote

  • Floor Drains

    Floor drains in kitchens, restrooms and mechanical rooms collect debris until they back up. We clear the drain and the line behind it.

    What's included

    • Clearing floor drain lines
    • Cleaning drain bodies and strainers
    • Checking trap primers where present
    • Flow test

    Common signs you need this

    • Standing water around floor drains
    • Sewer smell from a dry drain
    • Water coming up during washdown
    Get a Quote

  • Main Sewer Lines

    When the building's main line backs up, every fixture is affected. We clear the main from the cleanout and get the whole building draining again.

    What's included

    • Locating and opening cleanouts
    • Cabling or jetting the main line
    • Clearing roots and heavy buildup
    • Checking fixtures throughout the building

    Common signs you need this

    • Multiple fixtures backing up at once
    • Water rising in floor drains
    • Gurgling throughout the building
    Get a Quote

  • Camera Inspection

    A camera inspection shows what's inside the line, including grease, roots, sags and breaks. It turns a repeat problem into a clear plan.

    What's included

    • Video inspection of drain and sewer lines
    • Locating problem spots and depth
    • Findings explained in plain language
    • Recommendations for repair or maintenance

    Common signs you need this

    • Clogs that keep coming back
    • Planning a renovation or tenant change
    • Suspected broken or sagging pipe
    Get a Quote
